findings.description: Color index 0 is skipped for both foreground and background.
findings.rationale: Calling style(text, fg=0) or style(text, bg=0) selects the valid black entry in the 256-color palette. The new truthiness checks skip these values, so the output retains the terminal's existing color instead of applying black.

findings.description: Out-of-range palette indices and RGB components now produce invalid ANSI sequences instead of being rejected.
findings.rationale: Inputs such as fg=256 or fg=(256, 0, 0) previously raised ValueError. Removing the range checks allows these values into escape sequences, so callers receive apparently successful output whose color is ignored or interpreted inconsistently by terminals.
